These functions wrap the [plugin endpoints](/apps/supervisor-api/plugins/) of the Supervisor API. Plugins are the containers the Supervisor runs next to Home Assistant for audio, the command line, DNS, multicast, and monitoring. The function lists on this page are generated from the docblocks in the source of Bashio. The descriptions are the ones in the source, so some still say "addon" where this site says app.

Most of them need `hassio_api: true` and a role that allows the call, see [what your app may call](/apps/supervisor-api/#what-your-app-may-call).

## Audio

The audio server: devices, volume, profiles, and the plugin itself, from `/audio`. Source: [`lib/audio.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/audio.sh).

- `bashio::audio.update`: Updates the audio server to the latest version.
  - `$1`: Version to update to (optional)
- `bashio::audio.reload`: Reloads the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.restart`: Restarts the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.logs`: Returns the logs created by the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.volume`: Sets the volume on an audio stream.
  - `$1`: Stream type ('input' or 'output')
  - `$2`: Stream index
  - `$3`: Volume level (a non-negative number where 1.0 is 100%, for example 0.5; values above 1.0 amplify the stream)
  - `$4`: Apply to the application stream instead of the device (optional)
- `bashio::audio.mute`: Mutes or unmutes an audio stream.
  - `$1`: Stream type ('input' or 'output')
  - `$2`: Stream index
  - `$3`: Mute state (true to mute, false to unmute)
  - `$4`: Apply to the application stream instead of the device (optional)
- `bashio::audio.default`: Sets the default audio stream.
  - `$1`: Stream type ('input' or 'output')
  - `$2`: Name of the stream to set as default
- `bashio::audio.profile`: Activates an audio profile on a card.
  - `$1`: Card identifier
  - `$2`: Profile name to activate
- `bashio::audio`: Returns a JSON object with generic version information about the audio server.
  - `$1`: Cache key to store results in (optional)
  - `$2`: jq Filter to apply on the result (optional)
- `bashio::audio.version`: Returns the audio server version used.
- `bashio::audio.version_latest`: Returns the latest version of the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.update_available`: Checks if there is an update available for the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.host`: Returns the host of the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.stats`: List all available stats about the audio server.
  - `$1`: Cache key to store results in (optional)
  - `$2`: jq Filter to apply on the result (optional)
- `bashio::audio.cpu_percent`: Returns CPU usage from the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.memory_usage`: Returns memory usage from the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.memory_limit`: Returns memory limit from the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.memory_percent`: Returns memory usage in percent from the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.network_tx`: Returns outgoing network usage from the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.network_rx`: Returns incoming network usage from the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.blk_read`: Returns disk read usage from the audio server.
- `bashio::audio.blk_write`: Returns disk write usage from the audio server.

  - `$1`: Version to update to (optional)
- `bashio::cli`: Returns a JSON object with generic version information about the CLI.
  - `$1`: Cache key to store results in (optional)

- `bashio::cli.version`: Returns the Home Assistant CLI version used.
- `bashio::cli.version_latest`: Returns the latest version of the CLI.
- `bashio::cli.update_available`: Checks if there is an update available for the CLI.

- `bashio::cli.memory_usage`: Returns memory usage from the CLI.

- `bashio::cli.network_rx`: Returns incoming network usage from the CLI.
- `bashio::cli.blk_read`: Returns disk read usage from the CLI.
- `bashio::cli.blk_write`: Returns disk write usage from the CLI.

## DNS

The DNS plugin: servers, hosts, and the plugin itself, from `/dns`. Source: [`lib/dns.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/dns.sh).

- `bashio::dns.update`: Updates the DNS to the latest version.
  - `$1`: Version to update to (optional)
- `bashio::dns.reset`: Reset the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.restart`: Restarts the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.options`: Sets the DNS plugin options.
  - `$1`: Options object (JSON)
- `bashio::dns.logs`: Returns the logs created by the DNS.
- `bashio::dns`: Returns a JSON object with generic version information about the DNS.
  - `$1`: Cache key to store results in (optional)
  - `$2`: jq Filter to apply on the result (optional)
- `bashio::dns.host`: Returns the Home Assistant DNS host.
- `bashio::dns.version`: Returns the current version of the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.version_latest`: Returns the latest version of the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.update_available`: Checks if there is an update available for the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.locals`: Returns a list of local DNS servers used by the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.servers`: Returns a list of DNS servers used by the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.stats`: List all available stats about the DNS.
  - `$1`: Cache key to store results in (optional)
  - `$2`: jq Filter to apply on the result (optional)
- `bashio::dns.cpu_percent`: Returns CPU usage from the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.memory_usage`: Returns memory usage from the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.memory_limit`: Returns memory limit from the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.memory_percent`: Returns memory usage in percent from the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.network_tx`: Returns outgoing network usage from the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.network_rx`: Returns incoming network usage from the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.blk_read`: Returns disk read usage from the DNS.
- `bashio::dns.blk_write`: Returns disk write usage from the DNS.
